description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling repository-related API endpoints, including retrieving repository details by full name or ID. It includes model definitions for error responses and relies on external modules for interacting with GitHub and schema definitions.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing a standard error response payload with a human-readable message and optional code.

methods.name: get_repository_endpoint( full_name_or_id: str = Path(..., description="Repository 'owner/name' or numeric repository ID."), client: GitHubClient = Depends(get_github_client), )
methods.description: Asynchronous FastAPI endpoint to retrieve a repository's details by full name or ID, with error handling for not found and upstream errors.

ctags.name: code
ctags.pattern: /^    code: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Optional application error code.")$/

ctags.name: detail
ctags.pattern: /^    detail: str = Field(..., description="Human-readable error message.")$/

ctags.name: get_repository_endpoint
ctags.signature: ( full_name_or_id: str = Path(..., description="Repository 'owner/name' or numeric repository ID."), client: GitHubClient = Depends(get_github_client), )
